set +e
source /opt/intel/oneapi/setvars.sh >/dev/null 2>&1
setup_status=$?
set -euo pipefail
[[ "$setup_status" == 0 ]] || exit "$setup_status"
export MKLROOT=/mnt/xfs/AI_Models/runtimes/intel-mkl-sycl/2026.0.0_908-1.1/root/opt/intel/oneapi/mkl/2026.0

export GGML_SYCL_ENABLE_GRAPH=0
